study_design: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial with four supplementation arms
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The Age-Related Eye Disease Study randomized 3,640 patients with age related macular degeneration to 1 of 4 study arms, including placebo, antioxidants (500 mg vitamin C, 400 IU vitamin E and 15 mg beta-carotene), 80 mg zinc and antioxidant plus zinc.
reason: The abstract discusses prostate cancer diagnoses during a randomized supplementation trial but does not report an aggressive prostate cancer endpoint. The number of prostate cancer cases and the male analytic denominator are not provided.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: A significant decrease in prostate cancer diagnoses was seen in patients receiving antioxidants vs placebo (RR = 0.6, 95% CI 0.49-0.86, p = 0.049).
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported antioxidant estimate concerns prostate cancer diagnoses generally, without an aggressive disease definition.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There was no increase in prostate or other cancers with zinc supplementation.
